messages:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock the compliance handshake matrix for the NovaHealth pilot. Main asks: (1) structured audit export (JSONL) (2) BYOK KMS handshake + rotation window (3) retention lanes + legal hold. Goal: alpha for 2 customers by EOM. Thoughts?
Jorge (Eng): Can do structured export, but we need schema signoff from Legal/Security. Also perf implications for real-time streaming if we keep the full event set.
Maya (Security): Recommend a minimal SOC2+ evidence set as default and an "verbose" enterprise mode. Default should hash identifiers and provide a `forensic_enrichment` opt-in flag.
Sofia (Legal): Legal hold needs immutable snapshotting + a signed manifest bundle for exports. Also require an API for retention exceptions (subpoena/hold). I'll surface required contract language.
Liam (Sales): NovaHealth explicitly asked for 7y retention and BYOK in their VPC. They'll pay for archival storage — good upsell if we can commit.
Anya (PM): Proposal: retention lanes = ephemeral (30d), standard (1yr), enterprise (7yr). Legal hold overrides TTL and triggers an immutable snapshot + export. BYOK handshake: 3-step (upload pubkey -> handshake token -> confirm). Any technical/legal blockers?
Jorge (Eng): Tech notes: snapshots stored in cold tier with per-tenant encryption context. Rotation requires re-wrapping keys without downtime. We also need an SLI for on-demand evidence export (target <2h for typical size). Streaming full verbatim logs will increase cost; consider default sampling.
Maya (Security): Strongly +1 on sampling. Suggest defaults: control-plane events 100%, content-level logs 10% unless tenant opts in to full. Need to ensure sampling preserves forensics (no correlated cutouts).
Sofia (Legal): Contract items: key escrow refusal clause, incident response obligations, export certification language (signed manifest). I'll draft the clauses and flag for sales.
Anya (PM): Quick UX config mock (for Console) — example:
```json
{"retention_lanes": {"ephemeral": 2592000, "standard": 31536000, "enterprise": 220752000}, "legal_hold": true, "byok_flow": "3-step", "sampling": {"control_plane_pct": 100, "content_pct": 10}}
```
ops-bot: Created ticket INFR-4823: "Pilot: NovaHealth compliance handshake" assigned to Jorge (Eng). ETA 2 weeks.
Liam (Sales): I'll confirm NovaHealth exact event list and send sample contract ask. They also want SOC2 report attachments included in the evidence export.
Jorge (Eng): I'll prototype the JSONL export schema and a minimal infra cost estimate, post PR link by EOD Friday. Will include a staging export runner for large-volume tenants.
Maya (Security): I'll produce a security checklist for the pilot (key handling, HSM/KMS integration pattern, sampling safeties) by Wednesday.
Sofia (Legal): Draft will be ready Tuesday AM. Will mark any "must-have" items we cannot accommodate.
Anya (PM): Action items recap: Sofia — contract language (Tue), Jorge — proto export + infra estimate (Thu PR), Maya — security checklist & sampling defaults (Wed), Liam — confirm customer list & retention SLA (Mon). Reconvene Thu 9am PT. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
